_doc: Registry of the local texts an OA11 evidence row may cite (tools/bt/life/build_sources.py). class decides the tiers a row may claim (contract.json source_classes). Not in this list = not citable. Wikipedia, forums, blogs, auction pages and memory are never sources. Texts are untracked raw OCR under tmp/; sha256 detects a changed file.
